_meanings:
.²1 An affix added to nouns to show ‘possession’; {#Danavat#} possessed
 of wealth; {#rUpavat#} beautiful; so {#Bagavat, BAsvat#} <ab>&c.</ab>; (the words
 so formed being adjectives).
.²2 Added to the base of the past passive participle {#vat#} turns it into
 a past active participle; {#ityuktavantaM janakAtmajAyAm#} <ls>R. 14. 43</ls>.
.²3 Added to substantives in the sense of the locative; {#sUktavAke iti#}
 {#sUtrayitavye sUktavAkavat iti sUtritam#} <ls>ŚB. on MS. 10. 2. 51</ls>.
.²4 Added to substantives in the sense of {#arha#} ‘worthy of’, ‘deserving’;
 {#IhArTA sUktavAkArhAH . arhe vatirdrazwavyaH#} <ls>ŚB. on MS. 10. 2. 51</ls>.
